# Deepin Desktop Simulator

> A Deepin Linux desktop simulator built with Vue.js by Dawid Olko. It runs in the browser with a login screen, a dock, draggable windows, a terminal, a file manager and a set of demo applications.

## Pages

- [Home](https://linux.dawidolko.pl/): the simulated desktop

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer, author of this project
